svg.title: Grab-it in action
svg.desc: Capture part of the screen from the Capture & record… toolbar, annotate it with an arrow, a box, numbered steps, a blur and a note on a gradient backdrop, and copy it. Copy the code off a screen share as text, tidied up by AI. Record the screen, trim the recording, zoom in on a click and export it. Then search the Library for "invoice" to find a receipt by the text inside it, with an AI description and tags.
